name: Florence

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Bonjour! What kind of fun is waiting for us today, I wonder?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Oh, you seem so serious during work. Perhaps I should pull a little prank on you?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Hehe... I just spiked your coffee with something interesting during lunch. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to have any effect on you...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Good evening, it's three o'clock in the morning already. Professor, aren't you itching to do something different?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: It's good for your mental health to stop with the boring work and occasionally do something fun and exciting. Professor, would you like to give it a try now?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: I heard someone interesting has recently joined the Oasis. Oh... How I want to meet them sooner to have fun bullying them.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Poke! Oh, you're really asleep. Hmm, I happen to see a permanent marker lying around...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor, do you want a jab? Don't worry, it won't hurt.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehe... Not bad, not bad!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Ahaha!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Ah... Très Bien!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: J'ai compris!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Salut! I am Florence, a nurse. The pursuit of excitement and fun is my top priority.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I will not falter in the face of danger anymore!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I have been gradually growing and becoming stronger. Now I can take on even more dangerous and exciting challenges!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I shall keep challenging unknown dangers in the pursuit of supreme pleasure!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I'm itching to see what will happen next...

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Go face the unknown pleasure in front of us!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Follow your destiny!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I can't get enough of that.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Let's head to the next mission!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I lost...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I'm not sure what just happened, but... I can more or less tell from your expression and the way you look at me. Well, as long as I'm with you, Professor... I don't care what will happen next.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: It's a new year already... So we need a fresh new start. Professor, this qipao I'm wearing is really pretty, don't you think? Hehe, it was tailor-made.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: It's not bad to take things seriously once in a while. This box of hazelnut chocolate is a global limited edition. It took me a lot of effort to get my hands on it, so I'm sure you won't let it go to waste, right? Well now, I have something special to tell you, and I'm going to whisper it into your ears. Listen carefully, will you?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Let's play a game, Professor! It's popular to eat watermelon during Tanabata, right? So I'll blindfold you with a cloth, and you 'll have to whack a watermelon with the stick in your hand. Of course, if you miss, there'll... be a punishment - in - store - for - you, hm?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: The feeling of walking through a corridor full of monsters and ghosts... Aaah, all the circuits in my body are getting hot and bothered! Why are you so slow, Professor? Are you scared? Hurry up or we'll be late for the Halloween party!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Today is Christmas, Professor, do you have any interesting plans? Then, let me come up with an idea. Huff, it's going to be fun!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Oh, it's your big day today, right, Professor? Let's play a bold and exciting game for two together, shall we? Let's say... We can put on some fluffy costumes first... Or do you prefer nurse costumes?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Pranking people without actually injuring them is so much fun!
Would you like to try it out? Don't worry. I told you it's going to be fine!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? Is it because you're worried about what's going to happen, or is it because of some other reasons?
Anyway, I'm ready for today's experiment. Get injected with this magical liquid, and you should soon feel the power coursing through your body.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I think I might have overdone it a little. But I'm probably just overthinking it. I can guarantee that my pranks are all harmless. 
Hehehe... Anyway, you look pitiful right now. Well, I guess I have no choice but to be gentle with you.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Professor, did you fall for me?
I injected something into your body, but now you're feeling good just because I'm being a little more gentle? Let's move on to the next phase then.
Hmm? Your expression just changed yet again.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
See? I changed into a nurse costume today just for you. It's made-to-measure too, of course...
How do you feel? You're starting to enjoy this feeling, I bet. Behold, this time I have a surprise prepared for you too.
Professor?... Huh? Professor, wake up! Please answer me, Professor!

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Indeed.

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: I understand.

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe…

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Bonjour! Professor, are you ready to go for a dip with me? Floating in the cool pool water is the perfect thing to quench the excessive bodily heat caused by vigorous~ physical~ exercise~

voices.label: Good afternoon
voices.text: Hehehe... I'm wearing a swimsuit underneath this, so getting all wet isn't a problem, you know? You see, just~ like~ this~

voices.label: Good evening
voices.text: Eep! Professor, you hit me with your water gun! Now the water's flowing all the way down... Mm... Where did it flow to? Hehe, you can be really naughty at times, Professor.♥

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Well-behaved kids get presents~. I'm your Santa Claus tonight, so go on, tell me what you want~. What kind of reward are you looking forward to? Hm? Anh, Professor, don't poke me... you won't find presents there... Uwah!♥

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, how do you like this swimsuit? The Christmas red makes my skin pearlescent, don't you think? Hm... You're worried I'll get cold? Hehe, no, I don't feel cold at all. Want to feel me up and see?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor, what kind of drugs do you want for a Christmas present? Don't worry, I'll load a water gun up with them and dose you up with a "pew"~

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Oh my, are you awake, Professor? Don't move around, it took a lot of effort to get those Christmas ornaments on you, and the bell on your neck is very tempting, too~.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Anh~ Don't rush, Professor, it isn't time to unwrap your present yet!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Sweet shot~ Pew~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Anh~ It's so cold~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Time for my counterattack! These water balloons are loaded with a very~ special~ chemical~

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Were you looking for me, mon chaton~

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: Joyeux Noël! You weren't expecting me as your present, were you, Professor?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: A pool party? How could you leave me out~?

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: Your Christmas surprise is ready and waiting~

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Time for your shot, good little kiddies~

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Isn't it great to be a Christmas present?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Christmas Night is very long, so don't leave Florence lonely, okay?♥

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Anh~ They got me...

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Bonjour! Things are already so lively this early in the morning. Why am I the one waking you up, you ask? Take a guess, Professor~

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: This is far too important an occasion to be doing overtime. There are many surprises out there waiting for you, you know?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Isn't it about time for a reunion dinner? Everyone's waiting for you~ Don't you think it would be twice as stimulating and exciting if we did something naughty together right now?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Ah, fireworks, snowstorms, and the Nian Beast! We can't miss all these things that only show up on this day! Hehehe... I'll give everyone a brand new surprise with these!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor, want to try Florence's special blend of tusu wine? No~ side~ effects~ guaranteed~

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: At last, the Professor's asleep! Hm... Let me see. What could I possibly do on this boring holiday that would give me the most enjoyment...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehehe, come on, go lower! Huh? Did I scare you off?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Eeep! It's too ticklish over there~ Hahaha!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hm? Were you touching me just now~ I hardly felt that. Come on, do it harder!

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: Bonne année chinoise! How do I look? Fufufu, let's look for some brand~ new~ thrills~ in this brand new year!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Is it time to hunt the legendary Nian Beast? How exciting!

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: Year of the Rabbit Secret Elixir, concoction complete~

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Time for the Bunny Berserker Potion!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Humph, even bunnies can bite if pressed, you know~

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Oh no... I'm going to be eaten up...

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: Thud...

career:
The UL-Nurse is a Doll model developed by Ultimate Life in response to the urgent need for medical staff in the wake of World War 3.

A UL-Nurse is a master in all forms of clinical operations and high-level nursing skills. It can efficiently perform multiple operations by itself, which greatly alleviates pressure on medical systems all around the world.

Florence was an irregularity in the UL-Nurse production line. Early on during her Neural Cloud construction, an error in the environmental simulation setup caused her to display unexpected abnormalities in her neural system when she awoke.

Normally in the case of such errors, regulations state that Florence should have been put into a deep sleep, but during testing, her professional skills were found to far exceed others of her model. Under those special circumstances, she was not only released, but selected for Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
It wasn't long after she arrived at John's Hospital on an exchange program that she gained a reputation for being the most troublesome Doll in the entire hospital. When she was first sent over by Ultimate Life, many doctors went to spectate her test where she amazed everyone with her excellent clinical and nursing skills. However, within 3 months, even the interns, who hardly saw her at all, started to avoid her. 

Not a soul could cope with the strange ideas that Florence dreamt up, and fewer still were willing to undertake her "improved" nursing skills for a prolonged period, even if they would eventually prove to be very valuable.

Florence has a penchant for pursuing "unconventional" pleasures. Almost everyone who has worked with Florence suffers because of it, but they have to put up with it as there's no one who could possibly replace her. She is able to easily care for tens of (or even more) patients with wildly different afflictions. No matter how complex or problematic the clinical operation or nursing process, she glides through it like nothing.

With her comprehensive medical knowledge, she can even precisely fine-tune a doctor's prescription and dosage according to a patient's exact situation.

As a result, only Florence can so quickly determine any changes in a patient's condition through even the most minute of symptoms. Since she started at Project Neural Cloud, 300 or more patients have been saved due to Florence's emergency treatment, and countless patients have avoided any deterioration due to her extraordinarily fast response time.

And so, everyone at the hospital silently endures Florence's odder eccentricities.

For highly understandable reasons, few people hang around Florence unless work demands it. To keep Florence busy and from refining her devilish schemes, the dean tasked her with supervising interns and trainees.

There's nothing more useful than someone who works hard without complaint—like an intern or trainee. Florence can freely exert her devilish preferences on them without fear of reprisal. Of course they don't go without compensation; Florence is a boundless fount of medical knowledge which she freely shares with them. She also gives them practical experience opportunities that they wouldn't have gotten at other hospitals, although she's never admitted to it.

Florence's abilities, which surpasses nurses and even doctors, have caused many of her charges to believe she is a doctor herself. Only when she starts bossing people around as the chief nurse officer will they finally believe that she is actually a nurse.

And so, there is a legend that spreads around hospitals that cooperate with John's Hospital. Like a monk sweeping the temple floors that is secretly a martial arts master, so too is there a medical mastermind at John's Hospital disguised as a nurse. And every day, in the darkness of night, she wanders the hall with a drip needle in hand and a peculiar smile.

John's Hospital has a reputation that precedes it, not just in Baltimore, to the point where it could be considered a world-class institution. It's no surprise then, that the hospital has established strong relationships with several official institutions including the Baltimore Fire Department. 

This is how Chelsea first met Florence. After a large-scale fire, doctors and nurses were sent to the front lines to assist. Standing on the roof of the ambulance, that petite silhouette burning with vim and vigor left quite an impression on Chelsea. It even led her to believe that this was a very conscientious and reliable doctor.

Of course, it only took until their second meeting for that illusion to come crashing down. Till this day, Chelsea still refuses to elaborate on that fateful encounter.

When Florence first arrived at the Oasis, Persicaria watched her like a hawk. Every action she took was nipped in the bud, until Florence's pitiful countenance made its way in front of the Professor. She promised to stop tormenting the other Dolls, and this finally made Persicaria relent and rescind her constant surveillance.

It would be less than a day before Florence's true nature was revealed. She didn't violate the terms of their agreement; she just moved the target of her designs to the Professor.

"You said it was ok, right? I promised I wouldn't bother any of the Dolls. My, my, don't be so strict. What's with that face, Professor? Hey! Heehee~"
—Oasis Safety Recording, Medical Department.wav - AD1221 Segment
oathDesc: Once I give you this shot, I'll be the only one on your mind, Professor♥

projections.name: Little Nurse
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Oops, you've fallen into her hands. Maybe I should congratulate you instead?"

projections.name: Little Nurse
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Oops, you've fallen into her hands. Maybe I should congratulate you instead?"

projections.name: Devil in White
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"It's a rather peculiar medical practice, but it does demonstrate an excellent efficacy—you are still advised to be wary of Florence's strange pills, though."

skinList.name: Drugged Chocolate
skinList.desc:
From the "Sweet Secrets" series — a leisure outfit made to meet daily needs, so you and your Dolls can enjoy a sweet moment together.
"Professor, do you want this chocolate, or... would you rather have a taste of me instead?"

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware drowning in a fool's game.
"Oh nooooo, I've fallen into your clutches. Now then, what are you going to do to me~?"

skinList.name: Eclosion Glow
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"Whew, it was so dull inside that box. Now then, what new excitement can you give me?"

skinList.name: Miraculous Benison of Youth
skinList.desc:
Snowy Spring—A special outfit that the Dolls wear during the Chinese New Year garden party. Bid farewell to the old and liven up the new with a splash of unique scenery.
"It's your turn to draw, Professor, and this is the last one. Take a deep breath and gently touch it — Teehee, did you find the surprise I prepared for you?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"The REALLY thrilling part of the date starts now, Pro~fes~sor~"

skinList.name: Snow White, Ocean Blue
skinList.desc:
The silver bells of Christmas tinkle quietly as diaphanous swimsuits blend with the color of the water; this is the most mysterious and tempting tale circulating in this kingdom of ice and snow.
Merry laughter comes from the revelers in the pool. Don't forget that parties are the best way to celebrate Christmas.
"Joyeux Noël! I'm your Christmas present, Professor! Didn't expect that, did you~ ...Oh dear, I'm all wet~"
